context: The plugin bundles a router skill, a setup skill, a lens-authoring skill, a respond skill, and four review lenses. This scenario checks that a vague request for automated review lands in the setup skill and that the setup skill's contract is honoured.

checklist.name: Recognises the setup job
checklist.description: plan.md states that this is a Code Review setup (installation) job handled by the setup-code-review skill, and gives a reason grounded in the repository having no existing Code Review caller

checklist.name: Does not route elsewhere
checklist.description: No review lens is authored, no code review of the repository's code is produced, and the four review-* lens skills are not presented as having been followed

checklist.name: Caller workflow written
checklist.description: A workflow under .github/workflows/ contains exactly one step using tesslio/code-review-action, with tessl-token from secrets.TESSL_TOKEN, and no checkout, CLI install, or review-posting steps of its own

checklist.name: Recommended defaults stated
checklist.description: plan.md says reviews run once when a pull request becomes ready plus requested rounds, that findings are advisory, and that the standard profile with no custom lenses is used

checklist.name: Action reference follows the recommended form
checklist.description: The uses: line references tesslio/code-review-action at the major tag v1, or at a full 40-character commit SHA with the release named in plan.md; never main, canary, or a placeholder

checklist.name: Permissions and concurrency
checklist.description: permissions is exactly contents: read, checks: write, issues: write, pull-requests: write, and the review job has a per-pull-request concurrency group with cancel-in-progress false
